name: meeple-on-board-per-meeple-v1
description: R17 with a host chosen PER MEEPLE rather than per payment, so one payment may feed several neighbours. Identical to overlays/meeple-on-board-v1.overlay.json in every other respect. It is the rule Dean ruled first on 05/09/2026 and then ruled back on the branching factor, and it survives as the paired arm that says what the ruling cost in play: per meeple multiplies the build enumerator by roughly hosts^meeples and measured at 25,827 ways to buy one building at four seats against 4,063 per payment, with seconds per 4-seat game 0.277 against 0.152. Run it to find out whether the freedom bought anything at the table - the readings to compare are who receives placed meeples (the spread across seats) and the hook.
